figures.caption: Fig. 1. Overview of the β-TCVAE framework for disentangled nonlinear ICA in fMRI analysis. A. Training curves showing the total loss, MI, and TC during optimization. B. ICNs identified by the β-TCVAE framework. C. Average FNC across all HCP subjects, showing only correlations with |r| > 0.05.

Fig. 2. Representative ICNs identified by β-TCVAE and InfoMax. A. DMN and OFC components derived from β-TCVAE (colorbar indicates voxel intensity). B. DMN and OFC components derived from InfoMax. C. Spatial component correlations of the DMN and OFC from β-TCVAE and InfoMax, respectively. D. Unique spatial components identified by β-TCVAE, highlighting its ability to simultaneously capture two ICNs ( a⃝-VIS, b⃝/ c⃝-FR).
